current_suggestion.pitch: Boyle is a former hedge fund manager who explains markets, monetary policy, and financial history with data and a skeptical eye. That gives you a rigorous counterweight to the Saylor and Lyn Alden bitcoin/macro view you follow, because he takes on the strongest arguments against it. He also covers how markets, incentives, and risk work in practice, including gambling-adjacent topics like prediction markets and betting, which suits your interest in variance and decision-making under uncertainty. The format is solo, scripted, 10-20 minute explainers with a dry sense of humor and little price chatter.
